A College for the Future
USF’s Bellini College of Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity and Computing is the
nation’s first named college focused on all three disciplines. Through interdisciplinary
research, industry-connected education and partnerships with business and government,
the college prepares students to lead in a rapidly changing technology landscape while
advancing responsible innovation that strengthens Florida’s economy and global competitiveness.
Tech Career Advancement Program
The Tech Career Advancement Program, known as tCAP, prepares Bellini College students
to turn their education into a successful technology career. Through professional
development, hands-on learning, industry mentorship and real-world experiences, students
build the technical knowledge, workplace skills and confidence to graduate ready for
a rapidly changing workforce.

Building AI Confidence: New USF Microcourse Explores Agents, LLMs and Responsible AI Use
10/26/26 — The University of South Florida's new free, online microcourse, AI, Agents, LLMs, Prompting and More: An Overview, helps close that gap by helping learners understand how AI systems generate responses, where they can fall short, and how to evaluate their outputs.
Bellini College student turns cybersecurity experience into opportunities at Google and Cyber Florida
10/23/26 — USF Bellini College cybersecurity student Karishma Tallreja shares how hands-on projects, student leadership and career support helped her secure a Google Mandiant internship and a security analyst role with Cyber Florida.
USF receives $2 million to create Florida’s first university AI and Cyber Makerspace
10/14/26 — A $2 million grant from the National Institute of Standards and Technology will establish Florida’s first university AI and Cyber Makerspace at USF’s Bellini College. The facility will expand hands-on learning and research in secure, trustworthy AI and cybersecurity while supporting interdisciplinary collaboration, industry partnerships and workforce training to help strengthen Tampa Bay’s technology economy and prepare graduates for careers.
